lyrics.text:
Hey, hey, Frankie,
you gotta walk downtown far below.
Hey, hey, Nancy,
did you hide the other night? Or was it the green power that just came up real slow?
Everybody's got a reason to ride until the sun set down the horizon,
looking for the seasons to change its colors down on prison.
All the demons start to roll,
gotta hook up with the soul,
while the giant calls this what I owe.
Hey, hey, Sugar,
you got a hippie with some brownies down my liver.
Hey, hey, Cougar,
did you sleep the other night with some guy who stretched your cat so wide though you long for your man to adore?
Detention on the knee to hang your weight and chains down under prison.
Suspended down underneath from one palm to the other for a dirty reason.
All the demons start to roll,
gotta hook up with the soul,
while the giant calls this what I owe.
